summary: Per-frame AI steering blend: when the AI steering-correction flag (this+0x45FC) is set, refresh the difficulty-scaled steering limit this+0x457C as AIDifficultyScalar()*0.75; degrade the steering blend this+0x4434 when the lateral-slip magnitude (fabs of this+0x442C) is large at speed; compute a direction-weighted blend of actual steering (this+0x38C4) against the racing-line target (this+0x37CC) and smooth it against the previous frame target (this+0x4464); under low target speed it is re-blended toward a SuspensionRatioClamp-derived value with an optional byte-flag-gated (this+0x39F9) correction term stored to this+0x4028. Then run racing-line correction when the session mode matches (dword_7C56A8 < 5 and dword_7C56A4 == 7), clamp a track parameter from this+0x4538, apply tire grip degradation/decay logic gated on race-started (dbl_8AFEA0 >= flt_8ACF90 + 2.5), and finally clamp the blend against a track-segment limit (byte_5C3160 path, this+0x44B8) or the difficulty-scaled limit (this+0x457C).

operations.description: If the dword flag at this+0x45FC (17916) is non-zero, write this+0x457C (17788) = AIDifficultyScalar() * 0.75, refreshing the difficulty-scaled steering limit.
Compute v2 = fabs(this+0x442C); if v2 > 0.1 and speed this+0x4440 > 20.0, damp the steering blend: this+0x4434 = (1.0 - 0.7 * v2) * this+0x4434.
Initialize the lateral-slip correction output local v17 to 0.0.

Blend actual steering this+0x38C4 (14532) against racing-line target this+0x37CC (14284) with direction-dependent weights (0.3/0.7): v19 = weighted sum; then smooth against the previous frame target: v20 = (v19 + this+0x4464) * 0.5.

If smoothed target v20 < 0.9 and (speed this+0x4440 > 4.0 or flag this+0x446C): call SuspensionRatioClamp(this+12) to get v7; compute clamp value v8 = clamp(2 * (1 - v20 * 1.1111112), 0, 1); blend this+0x4434 toward v7: v9 = (v7 - this+0x4434) * v8 + this+0x4434; then if the FPU flag pair v12|v13 holds and byte this+0x39F9 is set, compute the correction v17 = clamp(4 * (this+0x4434 - v9), 0, 1); finally write this+0x4434 = v9.
Write the lateral-slip correction output this+0x4028 (16424) = v17.
Store the weighted steering target this+0x4464 (17508) = v19 for next-frame smoothing.
Racing-line correction gate: if dword_7C56A8 < 5 and dword_7C56A4 == 7, call AISteeringRacingLineCorrection(this).
Clamp the track parameter read from this+0x4538 (17720) via TrackParameterMinimumClamp.

Tire grip degradation/decay block gated on race-started (dbl_8AFEA0 >= flt_8ACF90 + 2.5). In-race: compare lap distance this+0x4484 against speed this+0x4440 with +10/+3/+1 thresholds - fully behind the field (no threshold matched) writes this+0x4438 = TireGripCoefficient(this+12) and clears this+0x4434; within +3 (but outside +1) sets this+0x4438 = max(this+0x4438, TireGripCoefficient(this+12)*0.5) and clears this+0x4434; within +1 with speed above this+0x4484 and grip memory this+0x4438 == 0 writes this+0x4434 = BrakeThermalModel(this+12) * 0.8; at +1 threshold crossing with zeroed grip memory clears the grip memory dword and the blend. Not race-started: if grip memory this+0x4438 > 0, zero it.
Final limit clamp: if byte_5C3160 is set, cap this+0x4434 at min(this+0x44B8, 1.0) when above; otherwise, if this+0x4434 > this+0x457C, set this+0x4434 = this+0x457C (the difficulty-scaled limit).

clean_pseudocode: if (raceStarted) { /* grip degradation by distance-to-speed thresholds */ } else { if (this[0x4438] > 0) this[0x4438] = 0; }
if (byte_5C3160) this[0x4434] = min(this[0x4434], min(this[0x44B8], 1.0)); else if (this[0x4434] > this[0x457C]) this[0x4434] = this[0x457C];
